parent_channels.name: Agency, Property, and Consequence

subchannels.name: Hands, Earnings, and Failed Sufficiency
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person's acts and acquisitions are gathered under the agency of his hands, yet neither accumulated property nor earned gain averts destruction.
subchannels.active_motifs: ruin and loss `ت ب ب:B001/m01`; deeds attributed to the hands `ي د ي:B009/m01`; self-directed earning `ك س ب:B001/m01`; accumulated property `م و ل:B001/m01`; sufficiency and utility `غ ن ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The hands function as the accountable source of action, while wealth and earning are the expected means of self-preservation. Their failure to suffice turns economic agency into an outcome-bearing scene: what was acquired remains attached to the agent but cannot rescue him from the ruin attached to his own hands.

subchannels.name: Power, Possession, and Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Strength establishes control, control becomes possession and command, and the subordinate party yields a hand in obedience or pledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: strength of hand `ي د ي:B002/m01`; possession in hand `ي د ي:B004/m01`; commanding authority `ي د ي:B005/m01`; surrendered or pledged hand `ي د ي:B006/m01`; possessive attribution `ذ و و:B001/m01`; settled and continuing order `ت ب ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A hand supplies the capacity to hold and rule, while possessive attribution identifies what falls within that sphere. Submission completes the social mechanism by converting another hand into an acknowledgment of the established order.

subchannels.name: Transfer, Favor, and Protective Aid
subchannels.scene_or_process: Goods or benefits pass from one agent to another through direct transfer, benefaction, and an assisting hand.
subchannels.active_motifs: favor bestowed by hand `ي د ي:B003/m01`; hand-to-hand exchange `ي د ي:B007/m01`; gain procured for another `ك س ب:B002/m01`; practical sufficiency `غ ن ي:B002/m01`; supporting and protecting hand `ي د ي:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Acquisition is not confined to self-enrichment: it can be redirected as a benefit secured for someone else. The favoring, exchanging, and protecting hand forms a transfer scene in which agency is measured by what it places within another person's reach.

subchannels.name: Skilled Labor and Accumulated Means
subchannels.scene_or_process: Manual skill produces gain, and repeated gain becomes stored property and material independence.
subchannels.active_motifs: skilled handcraft `ي د ي:B015/m01`; self-directed earning `ك س ب:B001/m01`; accumulated property `م و ل:B001/m01`; material wealth `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; independence from need `غ ن ي:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The skilled hand supplies the productive operation, earning records its return, and property preserves that return as durable means. Against the surface denial of wealth's saving force, the lexical scene isolates the ordinary labor-to-capital sequence whose expected protection fails.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human capacity becomes visible through hands that acquire, control, transfer, and answer for what they do.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 111:1 (`تبت`, `يدا`) assigns ruin to the hands, while 111:2 (`أغنى`, `ماله`, `كسب`) denies the saving utility of property and acquisition.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same hand that marks culpable action can also denote favor, direct exchange, skilled work, and protective aid.

parent_channels.name: Binding, Covenant, and Capture

subchannels.name: Twisted Line, Tether, and Load Attachment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fibrous material is twisted into a line that can tether, lead, climb, suspend, or secure a carried object.
subchannels.active_motifs: tethering rope and rein `ح ب ل:B001/m01`; braided cord `م س د:B001/m01`; twisting of fibrous material `م س د:B001/m02`; carrying strap or suspension `ح م ل:B006/m01`; visible load-bearing `ح م ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Twisting converts loose fiber into tensile cord, and the finished line converts force into attachment. The same assembly can lead an animal, support a climber, suspend equipment, or bind a load to its bearer.

subchannels.name: Covenant Carried as Trust
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bond grants security or access, then becomes an entrusted charge whose bearer must uphold its terms.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant and protected bond `ح ب ل:B002/m01`; connective means of access `ح ب ل:B002/m02`; entrusted charge `ح م ل:B003/m01`; culpable burden `ح م ل:B003/m02`; indemnity and financial liability `ح م ل:B004/m01`; surety and guarantee `ح م ل:B004/m02`; pledged submission `ي د ي:B006/m01`; protective alliance `ي د ي:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The cord's joining function becomes a social bond: it gives access, protection, or safe conduct while placing a charge on the person who bears it. Guarantee and pledged hand make the relation enforceable, whereas betrayal turns the same carried trust into culpable weight.

subchannels.name: Snare, Pitfall, and Cunning Capture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed line or trap intercepts a quarry, while cunning reproduces the mechanism at the level of human danger.
subchannels.active_motifs: hunting snare `ح ب ل:B005/m01`; figurative deadly entanglement `ح ب ل:B005/m02`; set hunting trap `ص ل ي:B005/m01`; cunning ruse `ح ب ل:B011/m02`; hand caught in a snare `ي د ي:B001/m02`; predatory limbs `ك س ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The line is arranged before contact, the quarry's own movement closes the trap, and predatory limbs complete the seizure. Cunning extends this physical mechanism into a social pitfall in which apparent connection becomes the means of capture.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An extended attachment joins things together, secures a relation, or closes around a target as a constraint.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 111:5 (`حبل`, `مسد`) presents a cord and its twisted material, with 111:4 (`حمالة`) supplying the adjacent action of bearing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A physical line can become a covenant that protects, a trust that must be carried, or a snare whose connection is hostile rather than sustaining.

parent_channels.name: Fire, Heat, and Kindled Conflict

subchannels.name: Fuel Gathering and Ignition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Firewood is collected and borne to a fire, where kindling converts prepared fuel into active flame.
subchannels.active_motifs: combustible firewood `ح ط ب:B001/m01`; gathering and carrying fuel `ح ط ب:B001/m02`; visible load-bearing `ح م ل:B001/m01`; kindling a fire `ص ل ي:B004/m01`; flame and ignition `ل ه ب:B001/m01`; burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fuel begins as material selected and assembled into a portable load. Bearing places it at the fire, kindling initiates combustion, and flame is the visible outcome of the completed supply chain.

subchannels.name: Entering Flame and Enduring Scorch
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body meets or enters a burning environment and undergoes flame, parching heat, and thirst.
subchannels.active_motifs: entering or encountering fire `ص ل ي:B003/m01`; burning fire `ن و ر:B002/m01`; scorching heat `ل ه ب:B002/m02`; heat-driven thirst `ل ه ب:B002/m01`; active flame `ل ه ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves from approach to immersion: fire is first encountered, then its flame surrounds the subject, and bodily experience resolves into scorch and thirst. The lexical heat states make the surface entry into fire a sustained exposure rather than a momentary contact.

subchannels.name: Carried Slander as Social Fuel
subchannels.scene_or_process: Harmful speech is borne from person to person until it kindles hostility between them.
subchannels.active_motifs: bearing a message `ح م ل:B001/m02`; slanderous carrying `ح ط ب:B003/m01`; kindling social harm `ح ط ب:B003/m02`; feud and enmity `ن و ر:B007/m01`; flame and ignition `ل ه ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech functions as a transported load and each delivery adds fuel to an interpersonal fire. The resulting feud is not merely compared with combustion; it follows the same sequence of collection, carriage, ignition, and spread.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Combustible matter is gathered and ignited, producing flame, heat, and effects that can spread through bodies or social relations.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 111:3 (`سيصلى`, `نارا`, `لهب`) names exposure to flaming fire, and 111:4 (`حمالة الحطب`) supplies a bearer and fuel.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Carrying firewood extends into carrying slander, so material ignition and the outbreak of feud share a single fuel-bearing process.

parent_channels.name: Household Continuity and Social Identity

subchannels.name: Marriage, Dwelling, and Ceremonial Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A union is established through marriage, marked by feeding, and sustained by residence, ample living, and material means.
subchannels.active_motifs: marriage and bridal establishment `غ ن ي:B006/m01`; socially self-sufficient married woman `غ ن ي:B005/m01`; ceremonial feeding `م ر ء:B004/m02`; settled dwelling `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; ample living `ي د ي:B014/m01`; material wealth `غ ن ي:B001/m01`; household property `م و ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Marriage initiates the household, feeding publicly marks its establishment, and dwelling turns the event into continued shared life. Ample means and property provide the ordinary material conditions under which that continuity is expected to hold.

subchannels.name: Conception, Gestation, and Birth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman contains and bears an inner load until the body opens for birth.
subchannels.active_motifs: gestation in the womb `ح ب ل:B006/m01`; internal pregnancy `ح م ل:B002/m01`; birth opening at the lower back `ص ل ي:B006/m02`; woman as participant `م ر ء:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The cord root supplies conception and pregnancy, while bearing names the fetus as an internal load. The anatomical birth opening completes the process by moving contained life from gestation into delivery.

subchannels.name: Parenthood, Nurture, and Uncertain Descent
subchannels.scene_or_process: A parent originates and raises a child, while a carried or found child can enter society with descent still unresolved.
subchannels.active_motifs: fatherhood `ء ب و:B001/m01`; feeding and raising the dependent `ء ب و:B001/m02`; carried child of uncertain lineage `ح م ل:B005/m01`; human person `م ر ء:B001/m01`; kinship attribution `ذ و و:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Parenthood combines origination with sustained care, making nurture rather than mere biological source part of the relation. The carried child reverses the scene: bodily presence is secure, but the kinship link by which society places that child remains unsettled.

subchannels.name: Names, Lineage, and Affiliation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Persons and groups are located through personal names, descent labels, possessive titles, and affiliations.
subchannels.active_motifs: lineage or nisba name `ح ب ل:B010/m01`; personal naming `ح ب ل:B010/m02`; proper name or title from flame `ل ه ب:B006/m01`; lineage or place name from flame `ل ه ب:B006/m02`; possessive title `ذ و و:B001/m03`; paternal relation `ء ب و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Paternal relation supplies one axis of identity, while titles, personal names, and descent labels make that relation socially legible. The surface name built from `لهب` participates in a wider naming mechanism in which ordinary lexical images become durable identifiers.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A household persists by forming unions, provisioning shared life, generating children, nurturing them, and locating them within a named descent group.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 111:1 (`أبي`) and 111:4 (`امرأته`) mark family relations, while 111:2 (`ماله`, `كسب`) supplies the household's material register.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Terms for flame and cord also produce personal names, lineage labels, gestation, and descent, linking physical continuity with continuity of identity.

parent_channels.name: Growth, Food, and Nourishment

subchannels.name: Flowering, Fruiting, and Vine Material
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vine or tree extends shoots, flowers, bears fruit, and leaves woody cuttings.
subchannels.active_motifs: vine and plant shoots `ح ب ل:B007/m01`; edible fruit or bean growth `ح ب ل:B007/m02`; blossom and flowering `ن و ر:B004/m01`; fruit-bearing `ح م ل:B002/m02`; woody vine cuttings `ح ط ب:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Extension produces the plant body, flowering marks reproductive readiness, and bearing converts growth into fruit. The cut woody remainder then moves from living vine into usable material, preserving the whole cycle from shoot to residue.

subchannels.name: Flock Feeding and Animal Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fodder plants and processing byproducts feed herd animals whose age, movement, marking, and illness require attention.
subchannels.active_motifs: camel-fodder plant `ص ل ي:B010/m01`; young lamb `ح م ل:B009/m01`; thorn-foraging animal `ح ط ب:B001/m04`; pressed oilcake `ك س ب:B004/m01`; livestock scent sickness `ء ب و:B003/m01`; aged or sore-backed pack animal `ت ب ب:B003/m02`; fire-branding of livestock `ن و ر:B002/m02`; skittish animal flight `ن و ر:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Plant growth and press residue become feed, while the lamb and foraging camel supply the herd participants. Branding identifies the animals, skittish movement complicates handling, and scent-borne sickness introduces the practical vulnerability of the managed flock.

subchannels.name: Grinding, Storage, Feeding, and Digestion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is reduced on a grinding surface, stored in a skin vessel, served, swallowed through the esophagus, and judged by its digestibility and sufficiency.
subchannels.active_motifs: grinding slab `ص ل ي:B009/m01`; cooking or roasting by fire `ص ل ي:B004/m02`; pressed oil residue `ك س ب:B004/m01`; skin vessel for fat or honey `م س د:B004/m01`; eating `م ر ء:B004/m01`; ceremonial feeding `م ر ء:B004/m02`; esophagus `م ر ء:B005/m01`; palatable food `م ر ء:B003/m01`; easy digestion `م ر ء:B003/m02`; bodily sufficiency `غ ن ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Mechanical reduction and storage prepare food for a social act of serving and a bodily act of ingestion. Palatability, passage, digestion, and sufficiency describe successive tests by which stored material becomes actual nourishment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Living matter flowers and bears produce, then enters systems of animal feeding, processing, storage, ingestion, and bodily sufficiency.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 111:4 (`حمالة الحطب`) and 111:5 (`حبل`, `مسد`) provide plant, carrying, and container roots, while 111:2 (`أغنى`, `كسب`) supplies sufficiency and processed yield.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pregnancy and earning roots reappear as fruit-bearing and pressed oil residue, joining biological production to food production.

parent_channels.name: Embodied Structure, Appearance, and Character

subchannels.name: Neck, Hand, Tendons, and Internal Passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Limbs and neck connect through cord-like vessels and supports, while an internal passage carries food through the upper body.
subchannels.active_motifs: anatomical hand `ي د ي:B001/m01`; neck and its front `ج ي د:B001/m01`; veins and tendons `ح ب ل:B004/m01`; esophagus `م ر ء:B005/m01`; back and tail-base anatomy `ص ل ي:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The body appears as a connected structure rather than a list of parts: cord-like tissues join and stabilize its exterior, while the esophagus forms an interior conduit. Hand, neck, and back locate that network across the body's working frame.

subchannels.name: Frailty, Dryness, and Internal Pressure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Age, weakness, emaciation, thirst, and abdominal fullness alter the body's strength and shape.
subchannels.active_motifs: human age and frailty `ت ب ب:B003/m01`; dry-wood emaciation `ح ط ب:B004/m01`; inner breadth or constriction `ح ب ل:B013/m01`; abdominal swelling and fullness `ح ب ل:B013/m02`; corded or slender physique `م س د:B002/m01`; heat-driven thirst `ل ه ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dryness and age reduce bodily capacity, while fullness or constriction produces pressure from within. Cord and dry wood provide opposing shape analogies: one draws the body tight and slender, the other leaves it depleted and brittle.

subchannels.name: Neck Adornment, Hair, and Visible Beauty
subchannels.scene_or_process: A graceful neck carries ornament, while hair, garment, bodily form, and modest bearing compose an admired appearance.
subchannels.active_motifs: graceful long neck `ج ي د:B001/m02`; necklace ornament `ح ب ل:B008/m01`; striking beauty `ل ه ب:B008/m01`; abundant hair `ل ه ب:B008/m02`; well-formed hair `م س د:B007/m01`; beautiful young woman `غ ن ي:B005/m02`; roomy garment `ي د ي:B014/m02`; modest aversion `ن و ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The neck is both anatomical support and a display surface for jewelry, while hair, garment, and proportion extend that display across the person. Modest withdrawal supplies a behavioral frame around visible allure, joining presentation to social demeanor.

subchannels.name: Manliness, Acceptable Character, and Steadfast Bearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person cultivates recognized virtue, remains acceptable in appearance and conduct, and bears hardship without collapse.
subchannels.active_motifs: complete manly virtue `م ر ء:B002/m01`; cultivated performance of virtue `م ر ء:B002/m02`; acceptable character `م ر ء:B006/m01`; pleasing appearance `م ر ء:B006/m02`; strenuous bearing `ح م ل:B007/m01`; supporting and protecting hand `ي د ي:B016/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Character is presented as something both possessed and enacted: the person takes on difficult weight, maintains social acceptability, and uses strength in protection. Visible bearing and ethical bearing therefore become two aspects of the same recognized personhood.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A person is configured through linked anatomy, bodily condition, visible presentation, and the conduct by which that presentation becomes social character.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 111:1 (`يدا`), 111:4 (`امرأته`), and 111:5 (`جيدها`) name body and person, with 111:5 (`حبل`, `مسد`) supplying the structural analogies.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Tendons, dry wood, braided cord, and flame become models for bodily linkage, emaciation, slender form, hair, and striking beauty.

parent_channels.name: Utterance, Invocation, and Discourse

subchannels.name: Paternal Address, Ruin-Curse, and Blessing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker addresses a father figure or invokes an outcome, with curse and blessing occupying opposite directions of efficacious speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: paternal form of address `ء ب و:B002/m01`; curse or prayer for ruin `ت ب ب:B001/m02`; blessing, mercy, and intercession `ص ل ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Vocative address establishes the interpersonal target, after which invocation seeks to alter that target's state. Ruin and blessing form a polarity within the same speech mechanism: one calls down loss, the other directs mercy or benefit.

subchannels.name: Song and Voiced Recitation
subchannels.scene_or_process: The voice is shaped into song or softened, affective recitation and can enter a ritual setting.
subchannels.active_motifs: singing and melody `غ ن ي:B003/m01`; modulated recitation `غ ن ي:B003/m02`; ritual prayer `ص ل ي:B001/m01`; blessing and intercession `ص ل ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Vocal modulation transforms ordinary speech into patterned sound, while prayer gives that patterned voice an address and purpose. Song, softened reading, and blessing meet as controlled uses of breath and tone.

subchannels.name: Mixed Speech, Slander, and Feud
subchannels.scene_or_process: Unselective speech gathers good and bad material together, then malicious report carries selected harm between people and produces enmity.
subchannels.active_motifs: indiscriminate or verbose speech `ح ط ب:B002/m02`; slanderous carrying `ح ط ب:B003/m01`; bearing a message `ح م ل:B001/m02`; feud and hostility `ن و ر:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The night gatherer supplies the discourse model of collecting without discrimination. Once such material is carried toward particular people, mixture becomes slander and the social outcome hardens into feud.

subchannels.name: Pointing, Questioning, and Relative Linkage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deictic and relative forms point out an entity, ask what it is, or connect it to a descriptive clause.
subchannels.active_motifs: relative connector `ذ و و:B002/m01`; demonstrative pointing `ذ و و:B003/m01`; interrogative “what” `ذ و و:B004/m01`; relative “what/which” `ذ و و:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Pointing first makes a referent available, inquiry requests its identification, and relative linkage attaches further information to it. These operations form a compact discourse mechanism for locating and elaborating an entity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech positions an addressee or referent, modulates the voice, and changes social relations through blessing, curse, song, inquiry, or harmful report.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 111:1 repeats `تبت` as a declaration or invocation of ruin and contains `أبي`, while the remaining lexical modes arise through roots at 111:2-4.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Gathering mixed wood at night becomes a model for indiscriminate or overabundant speech, while carrying wood becomes the circulation of slander.

parent_channels.name: Place, Time, and Ordered Movement

subchannels.name: Occasion, Anteriority, and Continuity
subchannels.scene_or_process: An event is fixed to a particular occasion, approached through what lies ahead, and understood as settled or continuing.
subchannels.active_motifs: temporal occasion `ح ب ل:B014/m01`; anterior or imminent position `ي د ي:B008/m01`; settled continuity `ت ب ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Occasion supplies the temporal point, anteriority organizes approach to it, and continuity describes what persists once the event or order is established. Together they form a minimal sequence from imminence to settled duration.

subchannels.name: Dwellings, Waymarks, and Starting Positions
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler or competitor is located by dwelling, landscape ridge, visible marker, named place, and a fixed station before departure.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling and former habitation `غ ن ي:B004/m01`; elongated sand ridge `ح ب ل:B003/m01`; route marker or boundary `ن و ر:B005/m01`; elevated beacon `ن و ر:B005/m02`; named place `ح ب ل:B009/m01`; race starting station `ح ب ل:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Dwelling provides a stable point of residence, ridges and beacons make the surrounding terrain legible, and the starting station fixes a departure point. The same spatial system can orient travel or organize a formal race.

subchannels.name: Leader, Follower, and Blazing Gallop
subchannels.scene_or_process: A leading racer passes first, a second competitor follows immediately behind, and forceful running raises a flame-like plume of dust.
subchannels.active_motifs: second-place follower `ص ل ي:B007/m01`; blazing gallop and raised dust `ل ه ب:B004/m01`; anterior position `ي د ي:B008/m01`; race starting station `ح ب ل:B009/m02`; continuing course `ت ب ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The starting station releases an ordered field, anteriority identifies the leader, and the next racer is defined by close following. The dust plume converts speed into a visible trace, making sequence perceptible across the course.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Scenes become navigable by fixing an occasion, marking what lies ahead, identifying a place, and ordering one mover behind another.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Flame becomes the image of a dust-raising gallop, while the prayer root names the racer immediately following the leader.

parent_channels.name: Material Work, Tools, and Transport

subchannels.name: Cutting, Grinding, and Rotating Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hand controls a handled implement or workpiece while cutting, grinding, and rotation transform material.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting action `ت ب ب:B004/m01`; broad grinding slab `ص ل ي:B009/m01`; iron axle `م س د:B005/m01`; handle or projecting end `ي د ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The handle couples the worker to the implement, the axle sustains repeatable rotation, and the slab receives pressure and abrasion. Cutting and grinding are distinct operations, but both depend on a stable interface between manual force and resistant material.

subchannels.name: Load-Bearing Gear and Conveyance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ropes, straps, mounts, and vehicles attach a load to a bearer or carry people and goods from one place to another.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible load-bearing `ح م ل:B001/m01`; conveyance by mount, vessel, or current `ح م ل:B001/m03`; carrying strap or suspension `ح م ل:B006/m01`; mount or litter `ح م ل:B006/m02`; tethering rope `ح ب ل:B001/m01`; handle or attachment end `ي د ي:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Strap and rope first secure an object to the carrying system; mount, litter, or vessel then supplies displacement. The channel joins attachment and transport as successive mechanical functions rather than treating carrying as unaided bodily effort.

subchannels.name: Twisting, Heat-Shaping, and Skilled Manufacture
subchannels.scene_or_process: Raw fiber or a crooked workpiece is reshaped through twisting, controlled heat, and practiced manual skill.
subchannels.active_motifs: twisting fibrous material `م س د:B001/m02`; heat-straightening a rod `ص ل ي:B004/m03`; skilled handcraft `ي د ي:B015/m01`; braided finished cord `م س د:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Twisting aligns loose fibers into a strong cord, while heat makes a rigid piece temporarily correctable. Skilled handling governs both transformations, converting unstable or misshapen material into a serviceable object.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human force is transmitted through shaped implements, rotating parts, attachments, and carrying gear to cut, grind, move, or fabricate material.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 111:1 (`يدا`), 111:4 (`حمالة`), and 111:5 (`حبل`, `مسد`) present the hand, bearing action, line, and material from which tool assemblies can extend.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Roots whose surface senses concern ruin and fire also name cutting and heat-straightening, turning destructive force into controlled manufacture.

parent_channels.name: Night Work and Endurance

subchannels.name: Blind Gathering and Hidden Calamity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wood gatherer works without sight, collects indiscriminately, and risks an unseen calamity while a steadfast figure holds position.
subchannels.active_motifs: night wood-gatherer `ح ط ب:B002/m01`; ensnaring calamity `ح ب ل:B011/m01`; steadfast brave figure `ح ب ل:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Darkness removes the gatherer's power to inspect what enters the bundle, making ordinary collection a route into danger. The steadfast figure supplies the counter-response: remaining fixed when concealment would otherwise provoke confusion or flight.

subchannels.name: Arduous Night Travel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler presses through the night under sustained effort and refuses to abandon the course.
subchannels.active_motifs: arduous night journey `م س د:B003/m01`; strenuous bearing `ح م ل:B007/m01`; steadfast brave figure `ح ب ل:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Night travel combines duration, obscured direction, and bodily strain. Bearing names the effort required to continue, while steadfastness converts endurance from passive suffering into maintained forward purpose.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Darkness obscures selection and direction, so work and travel become tests of judgment, effort, and steadfastness.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 111:4 (`الحطب`, `حمالة`) supplies the gathering and bearing frame, while 111:5 (`حبل`, `مسد`) supplies danger, steadfastness, and arduous night travel lexically.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The failure to distinguish wood in darkness becomes a discourse image for mixing sound and unsound material in speech.

parent_channels.name: S1. Water-Bearing Storm and Unbroken Lightning
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A dark cloud carries abundant water while repeated lightning illuminates the sky without an interval.
parent_channels.active_motifs: water-laden storm cloud `ح م ل:B010/m02`; rain and storm-bearing sky `ح م ل:B010/m03`; unbroken lightning `ل ه ب:B007/m01`; illumination `ن و ر:B001/m01`; elevated radiance `ل ه ب:B003/m01`; Aries as a celestial marker `ح م ل:B010/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Bearing transfers the logic of an inner load to a cloud heavy with water. Continuous lightning repeatedly reveals that load-bearing sky, while Aries locates the storm image within a larger celestial order.

parent_channels.name: S2. Ritual Prayer and Worship Places
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Worshippers perform an ordered prayer within a designated sacred place marked by an elevated beacon or minaret.
parent_channels.active_motifs: obligatory ritual prayer `ص ل ي:B001/m01`; blessing and intercession `ص ل ي:B002/m01`; house of worship `ص ل ي:B008/m01`; elevated beacon or minaret `ن و ر:B005/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The prayer supplies the repeated bodily and vocal act, the worship place contains its community, and the elevated marker makes that place publicly locatable. Blessing extends the rite outward from performance toward its intended beneficiary.

parent_channels.name: S3. Soot, Kohl, Tattoo, and Coating
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Heat produces a dark residue that is stored or prepared and then applied to the body as pigment or coating.
parent_channels.active_motifs: rising smoke plume `ل ه ب:B003/m02`; soot pigment for kohl or tattoo `ن و ر:B008/m01`; lime coating `ن و ر:B009/m01`; skin vessel for fat or honey `م س د:B004/m01`; pressed oily residue `ك س ب:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Smoke supplies the dark particulate material, oily or fatty matter provides a medium and storage context, and application converts the preparation into a visible bodily mark. Kohl, tattoo pigment, and lime coating differ in finish but share the process of preparing and laying a substance onto a surface.
